How do I register?

You can register on our website using the exact company name that is on your company's W-9 or
corporate return. Start off by verify your company's address, fill in appropriate boxes, then click
submit. Once you are you registered you can access the website features.

What if I forgot my username/password?

If you forget your username or password, click here, enter your email address and we will email you
your account information. If you forget your email address, please contact your sales
representative.

# **MUNRO- Laboratory Equipment UK**

Established in 1864, MUNRO has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying scientific equipment to
over 70 countries worldwide. MUNRO quality management systems meet and exceed many worldwide and
country standards. Our expertise in the supply of scientific products is backed by our qualified
design, build and customer service teams.

Discover a wide selection of laboratory instruments for various research and analysis needs. Get
reliable, accurate results with our advanced equipment.

## **Scientific Equipment**

Our mission is to empower scientists and researchers with cutting-edge technology that enhances
accuracy, efficiency, and sustainability. From microbiology to meteorology, MUNRO is your trusted
partner in scientific discovery.



Our commitment is to provide scientists, researchers, and medical professionals with the tools they
need to make accurate and precise measurements, so they can focus on their work. We understand the
importance of having reliable equipment and strive to deliver products that meet the highest
standards of quality and performance. Browse our collection and find the perfect solution for your
laboratory today!


 

Our warehouses are extensively stocked for immediate delivery. We offer a wide variety of over 3,000
quality Laboratory Equipment, unmatched customer service, and provide a unique level of after-sales
support and maintenance advice.

## Setting up your lab in Budget

RA Lab has established itself as a supplier of laboratory furniture and equipment. We have evolved
into a one-stop shop for businesses wishing to set up their lab on a budget.

### Space Managment & Material Selection

Space management and material selection are critical factors in the design of a laboratory. Proper
space management ensures that the laboratory is functional, safe, and efficient. It involves
carefully planning the layout and allocation of space to ensure that the equipment and personnel
have sufficient room to operate effectively. Material selection, on the other hand, is important
because it directly affects the durability, safety, and functionality of the laboratory.

[Know more!][54]

### Efficiency & Safety

A well-designed laboratory can greatly improve efficiency and safety. A well-thought-out layout with
an efficient work flow is critical for implementing efficiency. This can be accomplished by
logically organising laboratory equipment and supplies and ensuring easy access to frequently used
items. Lighting and ventilation are also important factors in increasing efficiency. To ensure
safety, the design should include appropriate hazardous material storage areas, fire suppression
systems, and emergency exits (e.g., spill containment). Furthermore, proper ergonomics should be
considered to reduce physical strain on laboratory personnel.

[Know more!][55]

## Setting up your lab in Budget

RA Lab has established itself as a supplier of laboratory furniture and equipment. We have evolved
into a one-stop shop for businesses wishing to set up their lab on a budget.

### Space Managment & Material Selection

Space management and material selection are critical factors in the design of a laboratory. Proper
space management ensures that the laboratory is functional, safe, and efficient. It involves
carefully planning the layout and allocation of space to ensure that the equipment and personnel
have sufficient room to operate effectively. Material selection, on the other hand, is important
because it directly affects the durability, safety, and functionality of the laboratory.

[Know more!][54]

### Efficiency & Safety

A well-designed laboratory can greatly improve efficiency and safety. A well-thought-out layout with
an efficient work flow is critical for implementing efficiency. This can be accomplished by
logically organising laboratory equipment and supplies and ensuring easy access to frequently used
items. Lighting and ventilation are also important factors in increasing efficiency. To ensure
safety, the design should include appropriate hazardous material storage areas, fire suppression
systems, and emergency exits (e.g., spill containment). Furthermore, proper ergonomics should be
considered to reduce physical strain on laboratory personnel.

[Know more!][55]

### Material Supply & Installation

RA Lab provides a comprehensive choice of high-quality supplies and equipment to satisfy your
laboratory's demands. We can help you save time and money by getting your laboratory up and running
as soon as possible with our in-stock furniture and vast network of suppliers, manufacturers, and
specialists, as well as our expertise and experience.

Advalab Scientific manufactures rugged lab equipment for US research universities, clinical
diagnostics labs, and industrial QC facilities. We design and build systems for high-stakes
workflows where precision and compliance are non-negotiable. From sample prep to long-term storage,

cleaners, high-flow fume hoods, stability test chambers, and lab-grade ice machines.

UL-listed, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 ready, certified ISO 9001:2015, 13485:2016, 17025:2017, CE-marked, and
GMP-aligned. Stay audit-proof and compliant. Spec your setup today.

## Setting up your lab in Budget

RA Lab has established itself as a supplier of laboratory furniture and equipment. We have evolved
into a one-stop shop for businesses wishing to set up their lab on a budget.

### Space Managment & Material Selection

Space management and material selection are critical factors in the design of a laboratory. Proper
space management ensures that the laboratory is functional, safe, and efficient. It involves
carefully planning the layout and allocation of space to ensure that the equipment and personnel
have sufficient room to operate effectively. Material selection, on the other hand, is important
because it directly affects the durability, safety, and functionality of the laboratory.

[Know more!][54]

### Efficiency & Safety

A well-designed laboratory can greatly improve efficiency and safety. A well-thought-out layout with
an efficient work flow is critical for implementing efficiency. This can be accomplished by
logically organising laboratory equipment and supplies and ensuring easy access to frequently used
items. Lighting and ventilation are also important factors in increasing efficiency. To ensure
safety, the design should include appropriate hazardous material storage areas, fire suppression
systems, and emergency exits (e.g., spill containment). Furthermore, proper ergonomics should be
considered to reduce physical strain on laboratory personnel.

[Know more!][55]

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially

requirements for research.
